To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the nonlinear control theory can be used to solve a wide variety of control problems, that it is a powerful tool for the control of complex systems and that the theory can be applied in practice to a variety of systems.

the nonlinear control theory is an important tool for the improvement of the performances of real life systems, but that its applications require a good understanding of the system, of the control objectives and of the noises, and the use of adapted coordinate systems.
the use of nonlinear models and control techniques is a must in order to achieve a good control performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of nonlinear dynamical systems, with a particular emphasis on control and filtering.
the study of nonlinear systems, in particular of nonlinear control theory, and with the applications to real life problems.
the development of new control methods and with the application of these methods to real life systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the nonlinear control theory has reached a maturity which permits to be applied to real life problems with a good chance of success.
nonlinear control theory is still in its infancy and that the future will bring a lot of new developments.

nonlinear control theory is a very promising tool for solving real life control problems.
